entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Applicant No. 1 and Applicant No. 2 both are in custody since 03/11/2022.

Earlier bail application of the applicants was dismissed by this Court on merits vide order dated 17.3.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 4491/2023 with liberty reserved to the applicants to renew their prayer after the FSL/DNA report are received or after the prosecutrix is examined, whichever is earlier.

Counsel for the applicants has drawn attention of this court to the FSL/DNA report which has been already filed in the trial Court in which the DNA profile of the applicants have not been matched with that of the prosecutrix and infact there was no spermatozoa found in the sample obtained from the prosecturix.

Counsel for the applicants has submitted the both applicants have been falsely implicated in the case and they are cousins of the prosecutrix and the objector has no objection if the application is allowed.
It is also submitted that the applicants are lodged in jail since 03/11/2022 and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Hence, it is submitted that the bail application be allowed and he be released on bail.
Counsel for the objector appearing for the mother of the victim submits that he has no objection if the application is allowed.
Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

Having considered the rival submissions, on perusal of the case diary, also the FSL/DNA report submitted by the applicants, further considering the fact that in the MLC report there is no definite opinion given as well taking note of the fact that final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time, this Court finds force in the submissions as advanced by the counsel for the applicants to allow the application.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicants is allowed.

The applicant no.1 and 2 are directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty Five thousand) each with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for their regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that they shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.
